source.label: Form 6-K, Total Voting Rights announcement (filed November 2, 2026)
source.quote: Ryanair announces that as at 31 October 2026: Ryanair's issued share capital consisted of 1,035,847,831 Ordinary Shares of nominal value ... each. Ryanair does not hold any Ordinary Shares in treasury.

notes: One class of Ordinary Shares, priced on the primary Euronext Dublin line (RYA.IR) in euro rather than the Nasdaq ADR (RYAAY). The count is from Ryanair's monthly total-voting-rights announcement at October 31, 2026, filed on Form 6-K; it is lower than the 20-F count (1,043,931,708 at March 31, 2026) because of continuing buybacks, and Ryanair holds no treasury shares.
